title: Kyrgyzstan takes first place in toguz korgool at the seventh Asian Championship in Kazakhstan

blocks.text: From 23 to 29 November 2025, the seventh Asian Championship took place in Kazakhstan, where the Kyrgyzstan national team won first place in toguz korgool! 🇰🇬🥇 We are especially proud of our student Dastan Masalbekov, from group ЖК-24-1 at Bishkek State University named after K. Karasaev, who was part of the winning team!
Congratulations to our athletes; we wish them continued success!
